verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa kāyaduccaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti kāyasucaritaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when someone has done bad things and not done good things, by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: vacīduccaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti vacīsucaritaṁ;
manoduccaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti manosucaritaṁ.
So ‘kāyaduccaritaṁ me katan’ti tappati, ‘akataṁ me kāyasucaritan’ti tappati;
verses.english: Thinking, ‘I’ve done bad things by way of body, speech, and mind’, they’re mortified. Thinking, ‘I haven’t done good things by way of body, speech, and mind’, they’re mortified.

verses.pali: ‘vacīduccaritaṁ me katan’ti tappati, ‘akataṁ me vacīsucaritan’ti tappati;
‘manoduccaritaṁ me katan’ti tappati, ‘akataṁ me manosucaritan’ti tappati.
Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā tapanīyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two things that are mortifying.”
